- Test matrix: 5 new install suites (5/5 passing) + CI matrix (ubuntu/macos × ruby 2.7/3.0/3.2)
- Bug fix: install.sh — guarded gh_args[@] empty-array expansion under set -u

Backward compatible: install.sh --minimal and --full legacy flags still work.

Supersedes #65 (consolidation PR).

author: bamr87
subject: fix(release): analyzer log helpers + Conventional Commits ! support
body:
The version analyzer silently crashed on every run because it called
log_info/log_warning/log_debug/log_error - none of which exist in
scripts/lib/common.sh. The version-bump workflow swallowed the failure
with "2>/dev/null || echo patch", so the breaking-change installer
rewrite (PR #76) shipped as v0.22.22 instead of the intended v1.0.0.

- scripts/utils/analyze-commits: define stderr-only log_* helpers;
  guarantee stdout carries ONLY the bump type; add Conventional Commits
  "!" marker detection (feat!:, fix(scope)!:, refactor(api)!:); tighten
  BREAKING CHANGE / BREAKING-CHANGE footer regex; recognise scoped
  types everywhere.
- scripts/lib/changelog.sh: mirror the same ! and footer detection in
  categorize_commit; recognise scoped types in the case statement;
  strip the optional ! in clean_commit_message.
- .github/workflows/version-bump.yml: stream analyzer stderr to a
  collapsible job group; fail the run if the analyzer crashes or
  returns an unknown bump type - never silently fall back to patch.
- scripts/test/lib/test_analyze_commits.sh: 15 new unit tests covering
  scoped types, all ! permutations, both footer styles, and
  stdout/stderr separation. Wired into run_tests.sh.
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased section documenting the fix.

author: bamr87
subject: fix(release): replace ((var++)) with var=$((var + 1)) in release path
body:
The version-bump workflow failed on bash 5.x runners because ((var++))
returns exit code 1 when var was 0 (post-increment evaluates to 0), and
under `set -euo pipefail` that terminates the script silently — without
ever printing the bump-summary block or any error message. Locally on
macOS bash 3.2 this never tripped, masking the bug.

Symptom: workflow run 24705543366 (commit d33e5e6, "feat(intro):
refocus Copilot Agent prompts...") logged
  [INFO] Analyzing 1 commits for version bump determination
then exited non-zero with no further output. Our hardened workflow
correctly refused to publish (no silent fallback to "patch") and
annotated the failure.

Fix:
- scripts/utils/analyze-commits: 6 sites
- scripts/lib/changelog.sh: 1 site
- scripts/lib/migrate.sh: 6 sites (defensive; same pattern, same risk)

All sites converted to var=$((var + 1)), which always returns 0.

Regression coverage:
- scripts/test/lib/test_analyze_commits.sh: static grep asserting both
  release-path scripts are free of ((var++)). 72/72 unit tests pass.

author: bamr87
subject: feat(welcome): add bare-minimum 3-file remote-theme starter
body:
Adds an onboarding experience for sites that consume the theme via
remote_theme with no installer:

- New _layouts/welcome.html renders a hero card, 3-step starter
  accordion (_config.yml/Gemfile/index.md snippets), embedded setup
  wizard, and Next-Steps grid when the site is unconfigured. Falls
  back to user content once site_configured is true.
- _includes/components/setup-check.html now flags a site as needing
  setup if it has no owner (founder/author/email) or its title
  matches a known placeholder.
- _includes/components/setup-banner.html links to /#setup-wizard
  instead of the broken /404.html.
- README gains a 'Bare-Minimum Starter' section under Quick Start
  documenting the 3-file pattern.
- CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased].

author: bamr87
subject: fix(footer,welcome,info): eliminate broken links on bare-minimum sites
body:
Make all theme-shipped UI elements safe for 3-file remote-theme consumers
that don't have /about/, /services/, /privacy-policy/, etc.

- footer.html: Quick Links and Privacy/Terms now resolve via
  site.footer_quick_links override or auto-detect from site.html_pages.
  Bare sites get only Home + Sitemap (XML).
- welcome.html: Next Steps card links now point to existing README anchors
  (#-quick-start, #-key-features) instead of non-existent #content-creation
  and #customisation.
- info-section.html: Admin Dashboard links and Environment link now only
  render when the corresponding /about/... pages exist in the build.
- dev-shortcuts.html: GitHub-based source shortcuts hidden when
  site.repository/site.branch are empty (was producing
  https://github.com//blob// 404s).
- cookie-consent.html: Privacy Policy link conditional on page existence
  or site.privacy_policy_url config.

All link audits on bare 3-file consumer now return 0 broken internal
links and 0 malformed external GitHub URLs.

author: Amr
subject: perf(jekyll): cache page-url lookups and short-circuit obsidian rewrites (#80)
body:
Reduces repeated full-site Liquid scans and unnecessary plugin work
during the Jekyll build. Profiled Docker build improved from 119.2s
to 86.8s (~27%).

- _plugins/obsidian_links.rb: short-circuit rewrite_document for
  documents without [[wiki-links]], callouts, or inline #tags
- _plugins/preview_image_generator.rb: build a single per-site
  preview index cached in site.data instead of re-scanning per doc
- _includes/core/footer.html, components/info-section.html,
  components/cookie-consent.html: replace site.html_pages | where
  lookups with a single joined-URL list + contains checks
- docker-compose.yml: bundle check || bundle install so containers
  skip a full bundler run on every restart
- CHANGELOG.md: note perf improvement under [Unreleased]

Co-authored-by: bamr87 <bamr87@users.noreply.github.com>
